segments.en:
From the region of the north, from the regions
of the north , forth rushed Angra Mainyu, the deadly,
the Daeva of the Daevas . And thus spake the
evil-doer Angra Mainyu, the deadly: 'Druj, rush
down and kill him,' O holy Zarathushtra! The
Druj came rushing along, the demon Buiti , who
is deceiving, unseen death .
segments.zh: 從北方的區域，從北方的區域，惡靈安格拉‧曼紐衝然而出，致命的迭瓦之迭瓦。惡行者安格拉‧曼紐如此說，致命的：『德魯格，衝下去殺死他』，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉啊！德魯格衝然而來，欺瞞的惡魔布伊提，是看不見的死亡。

segments.orig:
zarathushtrô ahunem vairîm frasrâvayat,
ýathâ ahû vairyô ... vâstârem,
âpô vanguhîsh frâyazaêta vanghuyå
dâityayå daênãm mâzdayasnîm
fraorenaêta, druxsh hê steretô apa dvarat bûiti
daêvô ithyejô marshaonem davazhå.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra chanted aloud the Ahuna-Vairya :
'The will of the Lord is the law of righteousness. The gifts of Vohu-mano to
the deeds done in this world for Mazda. He who relieves the poor
makes Ahura king.'
He offered the sacrifice to the good waters of the good
Daitya ! He recited the profession of the worshippers of
Mazda !
The Druj dismayed, rushed away, the demon Buiti, who is
deceiving, unseen death.
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉大聲誦唱阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞：『主的意志乃是正義的法則。沃胡‧曼諾賜予在此世為馬茲達所行之事。凡救濟貧困者使阿胡拉為王。』他向美善的水、美善的戴提亞河獻祭！他誦唱馬茲達崇拜者的信念！德魯格驚恐，衝然逃遁，欺瞞的惡魔布伊提，是看不見的死亡。

[i.e. Ahunwar ], a prayer in frequent use, and considered of great efficacy.
It was by reciting it that Ohrmazd in his first conflict with Ahriman drove
him back to hell ( Bund 1 ).
segments.zh: 〔即阿胡納瓦〕，一部頻繁使用的禱文，且被認為具有極大的功效。正是通過誦唱它，阿胡拉‧馬茲達在他與安格拉‧曼紐的首次衝突中將其驅趕回地獄（綱文 1）。

zarathushtrô, nôit hê apa-stavâne vanguhîm

nôit ushtânemca nôit baodhasca vîurvîsyât.
segments.en:
The Fravarane ( Y11.16 ). 3. And the Druj said unto Angra Mainyu:
'Thou, tormenter, Angra Mainyu! I see no way to
kill Spitama Zarathushtra, so great is the glory of
the holy Zarathushtra.'
Zarathushtra saw (all this) within his soul: 'The
wicked, the evil-doing Daevas (thought he) take
counsel together for my death.'
 
 I a. 4. Up started Zarathushtra, forward went Zarathushtra, unabated
by Akem-mano , by the hardness of his malignant riddles ; he went
swinging stones in his hand, stones as big as a house , which he
obtained from the Maker, Ahura Mazda, he the holy Zarathushtra.
'Whereat on this wide, round earth, whose ends
lie afar, whereat dost thou swing (those stones),
thou who standest by the upper bank of the river
Dareja , in the mansion of Pourushaspa ?' 5. Thus Zarathushtra answered Angra Mainyu: 'O evil-doer, Angra
Mainyu! I will smite the creation of the Daeva; I will smite the
Nasu, a creature of the Daeva; I will smite the Pairika
Knathaiti , till the victorious Saoshyant come up to life out of
the lake Kasava [Kasaoya] , from the region of the dawn, from the regions
of the dawn.' 6. Again to him said the Maker of the evil world, Angra Mainyu:
'Do not destroy my creatures, O holy Zarathushtra! Thou art the
son of Pourushaspa; by thy mother I was invoked. Renounce the
good Religion of the worshippers of Mazda, and thou shalt gain
such a boon as Vadhaghna gained, the ruler of the nations.' 7. Spitama Zarathushtra said in answer: 'No!
never will I renounce the good Religion of the worshippers
of Mazda, either for body or life, though
they should tear away the breath!'
segments.zh:
弗拉瓦拉涅〔Y11.16〕。3. 德魯格對安格拉‧曼紐說：
「折磨者啊，安格拉‧曼紐！我看不出有什麼辦法能夠
殺死斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉，他的榮光是如此之大，
聖者查拉圖斯特拉的榮光如此之大。」
查拉圖斯特拉在他的靈魂中看到了這一切：「邪惡的、
行事不善的迭瓦，」他想，「正聚集在一起商議我的死亡。」
正聚集在一起商議我的死亡。」
I a. 4. 查拉圖斯特拉跳起身來，查拉圖斯特拉向前走去，不曾為
阿克慕‧曼諾所阻，也不曾為他那惡毒謎語的堅硬所阻；他走著，
手中揮舞著巨石，那石頭有房子那麼大，這些石頭是他
從造主阿胡拉‧馬茲達那裡得到的，他，聖者查拉圖斯特拉。
「在這個寬闊、圓形的大地上，其邊界遠遠延伸，你在哪裡
揮舞著〔那些石頭〕？你這個站在
達雷賈河的上岸邊，在普魯沙斯帕的宅邸中的人啊？」
5. 查拉圖斯特拉這樣回答安格拉‧曼紐：「邪惡行為人啊，安格拉‧
曼紐！我將打擊迭瓦的造物；我將打擊
納蘇，迭瓦的造物；我將打擊派里卡
克納塔伊提，直到勝利的薩奧希揚特從
卡薩瓦〔卡薩奧亞〕湖中升起生命，從曙光之地，從曙光之
地升起。」6. 惡世界的造主安格拉‧曼紐又對他說：
「不要毀滅我的造物，聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊！你是
普魯沙斯帕的兒子；你的母親曾祈求我。放棄
馬茲達崇拜者的美善宗教，你將獲得
瓦達格納所獲得的福祐，那位民族的統治者。」7. 斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉回答說：「不！
我永遠不會放棄馬茲達崇拜者的
美善宗教，無論是為了肉身還是為了生命，即使
他們要奪走我的氣息！」

segments.orig:
paiti ahmâi adavata duzhdâmô angrô
mainyush, kahe vaca vanâi kahe vaca apa-ýasâi
kana zaya hukeretånghô mana dãma angrô-mainyush.
segments.en:
Again to him said the Maker of the evil
world, Angra Mainyu: 'By whose Word wilt thou
strike, by whose Word wilt thou repel, by whose
weapon will the good creatures (strike and repel)
my creation, who am Angra Mainyu?'
segments.zh: 惡世界的造主安格拉‧曼紐又對他說：『以誰的言語汝將擊打，以誰的言語汝將驅逐，以誰的武器善的生物（將擊打和驅逐）吾之造物，吾即安格拉‧曼紐？』

segments.orig:
paiti ahmâi avashata ýô spitâmô
zarathushtrô, hâvanaca tashtaca haomaca vaca mazdô-fraoxta
mana zaya asti vahishtem ana vaca vanâni ana vaca apa-ýasâne
ana zaya hukeretånghô âi duzhda angra mainyô,
dathat speñtô mainyush dathat zrûne akarane
fradathen ameshå speñta huxshathra hudhånghô.
segments.en:
Spitama Zarathushtra said in answer: 'The
sacred mortar, the sacred cups, the Haoma, the
Word taught by Mazda, these are my weapons,
my best weapons! By this Word will I strike,
by this Word will I repel, by this weapon will the
good creatures (strike and repel thee), O evil-doer,
Angra Mainyu! The Good Spirit [Spenta Mainyu -JHP] made the creation ;
he made it in the boundless Time. The
Amesha-Spentas made the creation, the good, the wise Sovereigns.'
segments.zh: 斯皮塔瑪查拉圖斯特拉回答說：『聖杵，聖杯，豪麻，馬茲達教導的言語，這些是我的武器，我最好的武器！以此言語我將擊打，以此言語我將驅逐，以此武器善的生物（將擊打和驅逐汝）啊，惡行者，安格拉‧曼紐！善靈〔斯彭塔‧曼紐〕造了造物；他在無邊的時間中造了它。不朽聖者造了造物，善的、智慧的主權者。』

segments.orig:
zarathushtrô ahunem vairîm frasrâvayat,
ýathâ ahû vairyô ... vâstârem,
frâmraot ashava zarathushtrô, tat thwâ peresâ
arsh mê vaoca ahura.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra chanted aloud the Ahuna-Vairya.
The holy Zarathushtra said aloud: 'This I ask thee: teach me
the truth, O Lord ! ...'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉大聲誦唱阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞。聖查拉圖斯特拉大聲說：『這我問汝：教我真理，主啊！……』

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ... ashâum drejya paiti zbarahe
ahurâi mazdâi vanghave vohu-maite ånghânô
ashâi vahishtâi xshathrâi vairyâi speñtayâi
ârmatêe.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O
Ahura Mazda, most beneficent spirit, Maker of the
material world, thou Holy One! [he was sitting by
the upper bank of the Dareja , before Ahura Mazda,
before the good Vohu-mana, before Asha Vahishta,
Khshathra Vairya, and Spenta Armaiti;]
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：『阿胡拉‧馬茲達，最恩惠的靈，物質世界的造主，持阿沙的聖者啊！〔他坐在達雷賈河上游的河岸邊，面對著阿胡拉‧馬茲達，面對著善的沃胡‧曼納，面對著阿沙‧瓦希什塔、赫沙特拉‧瓦伊里亞和斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提；〕

segments.orig:
kutha hîsh azem kerenavâni haca avanghât
drujat haca duzhda angra mainyô kutha hãm-raêthwem
kutha paiti-raêthwem kutha nasush apayasâne haca avanghât
vîsat ýat mâzdayasnôit kutha narem ashavanem
ýaozhdathâni kutha nâirikãm ashaonîm
ýaozhdâthrem barâni.
segments.en:
'How shall I free the world from that
Druj, from that evil-doer, Angra Mainyu? How
shall I drive away direct defilement? How indirect
defilement? How shall I drive the Nasu from the
house of the worshippers of Mazda? How shall
I cleanse the faithful man? How shall I cleanse
the faithful woman?'
segments.zh: 『我如何從那德魯格、那惡行者安格拉‧曼紐中解放世界？我如何驅逐直接的不潔？我如何驅逐間接的不潔？我如何從馬茲達崇拜者的家中驅逐納蘇？我如何淨化忠信的男子？我如何淨化忠信的女子？』

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nizbayanguha tû
zarathushtra vanguhîm daênãm mâzdayasnîm
nizbayanguha tû zarathushtra avaên ameshå speñta
avi haptô- karshvairîm zãm nizbayanguha tû
zarathushtra thwâshahe hvadhâtahe zrvânahe akaranahe
vayaosh uparô-kairyehe nizbayanguha tû zarathushtra
vâtô taxmô mazdadhâtô speñta
srîra dukhdha ahurahe mazdå,
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Invoke, O
Zarathushtra! the good Religion of Mazda.
'Invoke, O Zarathushtra! though thou see them
not, the Amesha-Spentas who rule over the seven
Karshvares of the earth .
'Invoke, O Zarathushtra! the sovereign Heaven,
the boundless Time , and Vayu , whose action is
most high.
'Invoke, O Zarathushtra! the powerful Wind,
made by Mazda; and Spenta [Armaiti], the fair
daughter of Ahura Mazda.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『祈禱吧，查拉圖斯特拉啊！馬茲達的善宗教。祈禱吧，查拉圖斯特拉啊！雖然汝看不見他們，統治地上七大地區的不朽聖者啊。祈禱吧，查拉圖斯特拉啊！主權的天堂、無邊的時間、以及瓦尤，其行動最為崇高。祈禱吧，查拉圖斯特拉啊！馬茲達所造的強大的風；以及斯彭塔〔阿爾邁提〕，阿胡拉‧馬茲達的美麗女兒。

segments.orig:
nizbayanguha tû zarathushtra fravashish mana ýat
ahurahe mazdå avãm ýãm mazishtãmca
vahishtãmca sraêshtãmca xraozhdishtãmca
xrathwishtãmca hukereptemãmca ashât apanôtemãmca
ýenghe urva mãthrô speñtô, hvatô
nizbayanguha zarathushtra imat dãma ýat ahurahe
mazdå.
segments.en:
'Invoke, O Zarathushtra! my Fravashi ,
who am Ahura Mazda, the greatest, the best, the
fairest of all beings, the most solid, the most intelligent,
the best shapen, the highest in holiness, and
whose soul is the holy Word [manthra spenta]!
'Invoke, O Zarathushtra! this creation of mine, who am Ahura
Mazda.'
segments.zh: 『祈禱吧，查拉圖斯特拉啊！吾之弗拉瓦希，吾即阿胡拉‧馬茲達，所有存有中最偉大的、最善的、最美的、最堅實的、最聰慧的、最好的形象、阿沙中最崇高的，其靈魂為聖言〔曼特拉‧斯彭塔〕！祈禱吧，查拉圖斯特拉啊！吾之此造物，吾即阿胡拉‧馬茲達。』

segments.orig:
vaxshem mê asãsat zarathushtrô, nizbayemi
ahurô mazdå ashava dãma dâtem nizbayemi
mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm huzaênem hvarenanguhastemem
zayanãm verethravastemem zayanãm nizbayemi sraoshem
ashîm huraodhem snaithish zastaya drazhimnô kameredhe
paiti daêvanãm.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra imitated my words from me,
(and said): 'I invoke the holy creation of Ahura
Mazda.
'I invoke Mithra , the lord of the rolling countryside,
a god armed with beautiful weapons, with the
most glorious of all weapons, with the most victorious
of all weapons.
'I invoke the holy, well-formed Sraosha , who
wields a club in his hand, to bear upon the heads
of the fiends .
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉從吾身上模仿了吾的言語，（並說）：『我祈禱阿胡拉‧馬茲達的聖造物。我祈禱密特拉，廣闊鄉土的主，一位用美麗的武器、最光榮的一切武器、最勝利的一切武器武裝的神。我祈禱聖的、好形象的斯勞沙，他手握著棒子，以擊打惡魔的頭顱。'

segments.orig:
nizbayemi mãthrô speñtô ýô
ash-hvarenå nizbayemi thwâshahe hvadhâtahe zrvânahe
akaranahe vayaosh uparô-kairyehe nizbayemi vâtô
taxmô mazdadhâtô speñta srîra dukhdha
ahurahe mazdå nizbayemi vanguhîm daênãm
mâzdayasnîm dâtem vîdôyûm
zarathushtra!
segments.en:
'I invoke the most glorious Holy Word [manthra spenta].
'I invoke the sovereign Heaven, the boundless Time, and
Vayu, whose action is most high.
'I invoke the mighty Wind, made by Mazda, and Spenta
(Armaiti), the fair daughter of Ahura Mazda.
'I invoke the good Religion of Mazda, the fiend-destroying
Law of Zarathushtra.'
 
 III.
segments.zh:
'我祈禱最光榮的聖言〔曼特拉〕。
'我祈禱主權的天地、無界的時間，以及瓦尤，其作用最為崇高。
'我祈禱由馬茲達所造的強大風靈，以及斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提，阿胡拉‧馬茲達的美麗女兒。
'我祈禱馬茲達的善良宗教，查拉圖斯特拉的消滅魔鬼之法。'

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm, dâtô
vanghen ahura mazda kana ýasna ýazâne kana
ýasna frâyazâne imat dãma ýat
ahurahe mazdå.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O Maker of the good world,
Ahura Mazda! With what manner of sacrifice shall I worship, with
what manner of sacrifice shall I make people worship this
creation of Ahura Mazda?'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：「善世界的造主啊，阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊！我應以何種祭祀來膜拜，以何種祭祀來使人民膜拜阿胡拉‧馬茲達的此造物？」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, urvaranãm
uruthmyanãm ava-jasâhi spitama zarathushtra srîra
urusta amavaiti imat vacô framrû, nemô urvaire
vanguhi mazdadhâte ashaone ashem vohû vahishtem astî...(1).
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Go, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! towards the high-growing trees , and before one of them that is
beautiful, high-growing, and mighty, say thou these words: "Hail
to thee! O good, holy tree, made by Mazda! Ashem vohu!"
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「往高大生長的樹木之處去吧，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！在其中一棵美麗、高大、強壯的樹前，你當說這些話：『向你致敬啊！善良聖潔的樹啊，由馬茲達所造的樹啊！阿舍姆‧沃胡！'」

segments.orig:
baresma hê uzbârayat aêshô-drâjô
ýavô-frathô mâ hê baresma pairi-keretem
pairi-kereñtîsh narô anghen ashavanô
hâvôya zasta nyâsemnô ýazemnô
ahurem mazdãm ýazemnô ameshê speñtê
haomasca zâirish berezô srîråsca vohu
manô râtaca vanguhi mazdadhâta ashaone vahishtô.
segments.en:
'[The priest] shall cut off a twig of
Baresma, long as an aesha, thick as a yava.
The faithful one, holding it in his left
hand, shall keep his eyes upon it without ceasing, whilst he is
offering up to Ahura Mazda and to the Amesha-Spentas, the high
and beautiful golden Haomas, and Good Thought and the good Rata,
made by Mazda, holy and excellent.'
segments.zh: '〔祭司〕應切下一根巴雷斯瑪樹枝，長如阿希，粗如一粒大麥。虔信者以左手持之，眼睛始終不離地凝視它，同時他向阿胡拉‧馬茲達及不朽聖者獻祭高大美麗的金色豪麻，以及善思和善法，由馬茲達所造，神聖而優越。'

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm, vîspô-vîdhvå
ahura mazda ahvafnô ahi abanghô tûm ýô
ahurô mazdå, vohu manô hãm-raêthwayeiti
vohu manô paiti- raêthwayeiti haca avanghât
tanvat ýat daêvô-jatayå daêva hãm-raêthwayeiti
bvat vohu manô ýaozhdâtô.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O thou,
all-knowing Ahura Mazda! thou art never asleep,
never intoxicated, thou Ahura Mazda! Vohu-mano
gets directly defiled: Vohu-mano gets indirectly
defiled; the Daevas defile him from the bodies
smitten by the Daevas: let Vohu-mano be made
clean.'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：「啊，全知的阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊！你永不睡眠，永不陶醉，你阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊！善思直接受污染；善思間接受污染；迭瓦們使他從被迭瓦擊中的身體而污染他；願善思被淨化。」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, gaomaêzem ayasôit
zarathushtra gaom pairi uxshânem bixedhrem dâityô-keretem
ýaozhdâta frabarôish zãm paiti ahuradhâtãm
pairi-karshem pairi-karshôit aêshô nâ
ýô ýaozhdâthryô.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Thou shalt
take some gomez from a bull ungelded and such as
the law requires it. Thou shalt take
the man who is to be cleansed to the field made by Ahura, and
the man that is to cleanse him shall draw the furrows.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「你應取一些來自未去勢的公牛的戈麥，即法律所要求的那種戈麥。你應將被淨化的人帶到由阿胡拉所造的田野裡去，而淨化他的人應劃出犁溝。

segments.orig:
satem ashô-stûitinãm upastvôish bizhvat
ahunem vairîm frasrâvayôish, catura frasnana
frasnayôit gaomaêzem gava dâtayå bish
âpem mazdadhâtayå.
segments.en:
'He shall recite a hundred Ashem vohu: "Holiness is the best
of all good: it is also happiness. Happy the man who is holy
with perfect holiness!"
'He shall chant two hundred Ahuna-Vairya: "The will of the
Lord is the law of righteousness. The gifts of Vohu-mano to the
deeds done in this world for Mazda! He who relieves the poor
makes Ahura king."
'He shall wash himself four times with the
gomez from the ox, and twice with the water made
by Mazda.
segments.zh:
'他應背誦一百遍阿舍姆‧沃胡：「潔淨是一切美善中最好的；它也是幸福。潔淨者以圓滿的潔淨而幸福啊！」
'他應吟誦二百遍阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞：「主之意志乃正義之法。善思之禮賜予在此世界為馬茲達所行之事！誰救濟貧困者，誰使阿胡拉為王。」
'他應以公牛之戈麥洗四次，以馬茲達所造之水洗兩次。

segments.orig:
ýaozhdâta bun vohu manô ýaozhdâta
bun mashyô uzgeurvayât vohu manô hâvôya
bâzvô dashinaca dashina bâzvô hâvayaca,
âat vohu manô nidaidhîsh sûrô-thwarshtanãm
raocanghãm ýat hê stârãm bakhô-dâtanãm
aiwi raocayåñte vîspem â ahmât
ýat hê nava xshafna sacåñte.
segments.en:
'Thus Vohu-mano shall be made clean, and clean shall be the
man. The man shall take up Vohu-mano with the left arm and the
right, with the right arm and the left: and thou shalt lay down
Vohu-mano under the mighty light of the heavens by the light of
the stars made by the gods, until nine nights have passed away.
segments.zh: '如是善思應被淨化，人亦應被淨化。人應以左臂和右臂、右臂和左臂托起善思；你應將善思置於天體的強大光芒之下，由諸神所造的星光之下，直至九夜已過。

segments.orig:
âat pasca nava-xshaparât âthre zaothrå
frabarôish xrûzhdranãm aêsmanãm
âthre frabarôish vohu-gaonanãm baoidhinãm
âthre frabarôish vohu manô â-baodhayaêta.
segments.en:
'When nine nights have passed away,
thou shalt bring libations unto the fire, thou shalt
bring hard wood unto the fire, thou shalt bring
incense of Vohu-gaona unto the fire, and thou
shalt perfume Vohu-mano therewith.
segments.zh: 「九夜過去之後，汝應向火獻祭酒，汝應向火獻上硬木，汝應向火獻上沃胡-高亞納的香薰，汝應以此薰祭沃胡-曼諾。」

segments.orig:
ýaozhdâta bun vohu manô ýaozhdâta
bun mashyô uzgeurvayât vohu manô hâvôya
bâzvô dashinaca dashina bâzvô haoyaca
fravaocat vohu manô, nemô ahurâi mazdâi
nemô ameshaêibyô speñtaêibyô
nemô anyaêshãm ashaonãm!
segments.en:
'Thus shall Vohu-mano be made clean,
and clean shall be the man. He shall take up
Vohu-mano with the right arm and the left, with
the left arm and the right, and Vohu-mano shall
say aloud: "Glory be to Ahura Mazda! Glory be
to the Amesha-Spentas! Glory be to all the other
holy beings."'
segments.zh: 「如是沃胡-曼諾應得淨禮，人亦應得淨禮。彼應以右臂與左臂、左臂與右臂取起沃胡-曼諾，而沃胡-曼諾應大聲說：『榮光於阿胡拉‧馬茲達！榮光於不朽聖者！榮光於所有其他持阿沙的聖者！』」

segments.orig:
peresat zarathushtrô ahurem mazdãm, vîspô-vîdhvå
ahura mazda haxshâne narem ashavanem haxshâne nâirikãm
ashaonîm haxshâne drvatãm daêvayasnanãm
merezujîtîm mashyânãm zãm ahuradhâtãm
nipârayañta âpem taciñtãm ýavanãm
uruthmãm anyãm hê avaretãm nipârayañta,
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, haxshaêsha ashâum
zarathushtra.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra asked Ahura Mazda: 'O
thou all-knowing Ahura Mazda: Should I urge
upon the godly man, should I urge upon the godly
woman, should I urge upon the wicked Daeva-worshipper
who lives in sin, to give the earth
made by Ahura, the water that runs, the corn
that grows, and all the rest of their wealth?'
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Thou shouldst, O holy Zarathushtra.'
segments.zh:
查拉圖斯特拉問阿胡拉‧馬茲達：「全知的阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊，我應否勸導虔信者、勸導虔信女、勸導生活在罪中的邪惡迭瓦崇拜者，去施與阿胡拉所造的地、流動的水、生長的穀物與他們所有財富的其餘部分？」
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「汝應當這樣行，聖者查拉圖斯特拉。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... dva tâ dâthra bavaiñti
dva tâ dâthra pârayeiñti dva tâ
dâthra pairi-bavaiñti dva tâ dâthra paiti
hañjaseñti mashyô astvaiñti anghvô
havâi urune para-daidhyât.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Where are the
rewards given? Where does the rewarding take place? Where is
the rewarding fulfilled? Whereto do men come to take the reward
that, during their life in the material world, they have won for
their souls?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！報酬在何處得與？報酬在何處進行？報酬在何處完成？人們往何處去領取報酬，即他們在物質世界的生命中為其靈魂所贏得的？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, pasca para-iristahe
mashyehe pasca frasaxtahe mashyehe pasca pairithnem dereniñti
daêva drvañtô duzhdånghô, thrityå
xshapô vîusaiti ushi raocaiti bâmya gairinãm
ashahvâthranãm âsenaoiti mithrem huzaênem
hvarexshaêtem uzyôraiti,
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'When the man is dead, when his time
is over, then the wicked, evil-doing Daevas cut off his eyesight.
On the third night, when the dawn appears and brightens up, when
Mithra, the god with beautiful weapons, reaches the all-happy
mountains, and the sun is rising:
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「人死亡時，人的時間終結時，邪惡、造作惡行的迭瓦奪去其視覺。第三夜，黎明出現、光明普照時，當持美麗武器的密特拉神到達全幸福的山嶺、太陽升起時：」

segments.orig:
vîzareshô daêvô nãma spitama
zarathushtra urvânem bastem vâdhayeiti drvatãm
daêvayasnanãm merezujîtîm mashyânãm,
pathãm zrvô-dâtanãm jasaiti ýasca
drvaite ýasca ashaone cinvat-peretûm mazdadhâtãm
baodhasca urvânemca ýâtem gaêthanãm
paiti-jaidhyeiñti dâtem astvaiñti anghvô.
segments.en:
'Then the fiend, named Vizaresha,
O Spitama Zarathushtra, carries off in bonds the
souls of the wicked Daeva-worshippers who live
in sin. The soul enters the way made by Time,
and open both to the wicked and to the righteous.
At the head of the Chinwad bridge, the holy bridge
made by Mazda, they ask for their spirits and souls
the reward for the worldly goods which they gave
away here below.
segments.zh: 「則名為維扎雷沙的魔鬼啊，聖者斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉，用鎖鏈帶走生活在罪中的邪惡迭瓦崇拜者的靈魂。靈魂進入時間所造的道路，此路對邪惡者與正義者雙雙開放。在馬茲達所造的聖橋——欽瓦特橋的頭部，他們向其精靈與靈魂求問他們在此下界所施捨的世間財物的報酬。」

segments.orig:
hâu srîra kereta taxma huraodha jasaiti spânavaiti
nivavaiti pasvaiti ýaoxshtavaiti hunaravaiti, [hâ
drvatãm akhem urvânô temô-hva nizarshaite,]
hâ ashâunãm urvânô tarasca harãm
berezaitîm âsenaoiti tarô cinvatô peretûm
vîdhârayeiti haêtô mainyavanãm
ýazatanãm.
segments.en:
'Then comes the beautiful, well-shapen,
strong and well-formed maid, with the dogs at her
sides, one who can distinguish, who has many
children, happy, and of high understanding.
'She makes the soul of the righteous one go
up above the Hara-berezaiti; above the Chinwad
bridge she places it in the presence of the heavenly gods themselves.
segments.zh:
「則美麗、勻稱、強壯、外形優美的少女到來，身傍有犬相隨，能分辨善惡，有眾多子嗣，幸福且具高度智慧。
「她使正義者的靈魂升起，越過哈拉-貝雷紮伊提；超越欽瓦特橋，她將其置於天上神祇本身的面前。」

segments.orig:
usehishtat vohu manô haca gâtvô zaranyô-
keretô fravaocat vohu manô, kadha-nô idha ashâum
agatô ithyejanghatat haca anghaot aithyajanghem ahûm
â.
segments.en:
'Up rises Vohu-mano from his golden
seat; Vohu-mano exclaims: "How hast thou come
to us, thou Holy One, from that decaying world into
this undecaying one?"
segments.zh: 「沃胡-曼諾自其金色座位上升起；沃胡-曼諾大呼：『聖者啊，汝如何自那衰敗之世來至我等之不衰敗之世？』」

segments.orig:
xshnûtô ashaonãm urvânô pârayeiñti
avi ahurahe mazdå avi ameshanãm speñtanãm
avi gâtvô zaranyô- keretô avi garô
nmânem maêthanem ahurahe mazdå maêthanem
ameshanãm speñtanãm maêthanem anyaêshãm
ashaonãm.
segments.en:
'Gladly pass the souls of the righteous
to the golden seat of Ahura Mazda, to the golden
seat of the Amesha-Spentas, to the Garo-nmanem,
the abode of Ahura Mazda, the abode of the
Amesha-Spentas, the abode of all the other holy beings.
segments.zh: 正直者的靈魂欣然通往阿胡拉‧馬茲達的金座，通往不朽聖者的金座，通往迦羅‧那麻涅姆，阿胡拉‧馬茲達的住處，不朽聖者的住處，所有其他聖者的住處。

segments.orig:
ýaozhdâthryô ashava pasca para-iristîm
daêva drvañtô duzhdånghô baodhem
avatha fratereseñti ýatha maêshi vehrkavaiti
vehrkat haca frataresaiti.
segments.en:
'As to the godly man that has been cleansed, the wicked
evil-doing Daevas tremble at the perfume of his soul after death,
as doth a sheep on which a wolf is pouncing.
segments.zh: 至於已被淨化的敬神者，邪惡作孽的迭瓦在其死後害怕他的靈魂的芬芳，如同一隻綿羊在狼撲向它時所害怕的那樣。

segments.orig:
narô ashavanô hãm-bavaiñti nairyô
sanghô hãm-bavaiti ashtô mazdå ahurahe
mrûidhi nairyô sanghô, hvatô nizbayanguha
zarathushtra imat dãma ýat ahurahe mazdå.
segments.en:
'The souls of the righteous are gathered together there:
Nairyo-sangha is with them; a messenger of Ahura Mazda is
Nairyo-sangha.
Ila. 
'Invoke, O Zarathushtra! this very creation of Ahura Mazda.'
segments.zh: 正直者的靈魂聚集在那裡：奈魯約‧桑加與他們同在；奈魯約‧桑加是阿胡拉‧馬茲達的使者。伊拉。'祈禱吧，查拉圖斯特拉！這正是阿胡拉‧馬茲達的造物。'

segments.orig:
vaxshem mê asãsat zarathushtrô, nizbayemi
ahurô mazdå ashava dâmi-dâtem nizbayemi
zãm ahuradhâtãm âpem mazdadhâtãm
urvarãm ashaonîm nizbayemi zrayô vourukashem
nizbayemi asmanem hvanvañtem nizbayemi anakhra raocå
hvadhâtå.
segments.en:
Zarathushtra imitated those words of
mine: 'I invoke the holy world, made by Ahura Mazda.
'I invoke the earth made by Ahura, the water made by Mazda,
the holy trees.
'I invoke the sea Vouru-kasha.
'I invoke the beautiful Heaven.
'I invoke the endless and sovereign Light.'
segments.zh: 查拉圖斯特拉模仿了我的這些話語：'我祈禱聖潔的世界，由阿胡拉‧馬茲達所造。'我祈禱由阿胡拉所造的大地，由馬茲達所造的水，聖潔的樹木。'我祈禱沃魯‧卡沙海。'我祈禱美麗的天穹。'我祈禱無盡與主權的光芒。'

segments.orig:
nizbayemi vahishtem ahûm ashaonãm raocanghem
vîspô-hvâthrem nizbayemi garô nmânem
maêthanem ahurahe mazdå maêthanem ameshanãm
speñtanãm maêthanem anyaêshãm
ashaonãm nizbayemi misvânahe gâtvahe hvadhâtahe
cinvat-peretûm mazdadhâtãm.
segments.en:
'I invoke the bright, blissful Paradise of the Holy Ones.
'I invoke the Garo-nmanem, the abode of Ahura Mazda, the
abode of the Amesha-Spentas, the abode of all the other holy
beings.
'I invoke the sovereign Place of Eternal Weal,
and the Chinwad bridge made by Mazda.
segments.zh: '我祈禱聖者的明亮、福樂的天堂。'我祈禱迦羅‧那麻涅姆，阿胡拉‧馬茲達的住處，不朽聖者的住處，所有其他聖者的住處。'我祈禱主權的永福之地，以及由馬茲達所造的正智橋。

segments.orig:
nizbayemi saokãm vanguhîm vouru-dôithrãm
nizbayemi ukhrå ashâunãm fravashayô vîspå
dâmãn savanguhaitish nizbayemi verethrakhnem ahuradhâtem
barô-hvarenô mazdadhâtem nizbayemi tishtrîm
stârem raêvañtem hvarenanguhañtem gêush
kehrpa zaranyô-sravahe.
segments.en:
'I invoke the good Saoka, who has the good eye.
'I invoke the whole creation of weal.
'I invoke the mighty Fravashis of the righteous.
'I invoke Verethraghna, made by Ahura, who
wears the Glory made by Mazda.
'I invoke Tishtrya, the bright and glorious star,
in the shape of a golden-horned bull.
segments.zh: '我祈禱善良的薩奧卡，持有善目的者。'我祈禱所有福樂的造物。'我祈禱正直者的強大弗拉瓦希。'我祈禱由阿胡拉所造的維烈特拉格納，持有由馬茲達所造的榮耀者。'我祈禱提什特里亞，明亮而榮耀的星辰，具有金角公牛的形態。

segments.orig:
nizbayemi gâthâbyô speñtâbyô
ratuxshathrâbyô ashaonibyô nizbayemi ahunavaityå
gâthayå nizbayemi ushtavaityå gâthayå
nizbayemi speñtâ-mainyêush gâthayå
nizbayemi vohuxshathrayå gâthayå nizbayemi vahishtôishtôish
gâthayå.
segments.zh: '我祈禱聖潔、恩惠的迦薩，統治諸位陸圖的者。'我祈禱阿胡納瓦伊提迦薩；'我祈禱烏什塔瓦伊提迦薩；'我祈禱斯彭塔‧邁紐什迦薩；'我祈禱沃胡赫沙特拉迦薩；'我祈禱瓦希什托伊什提迦薩。

segments.orig:
nizbayemi avat karshvare ýat arezahe savahe nizbayemi
avat karshvare ýat fradadhafshu vîdadhafshu nizbayemi
avat karshvare ýat vouru-bareshti vouru-jareshti nizbayemi
imat karshvare ýat hvanirathem bâmîm nizbayemi
haêtumeñtem raêvañtem hvarenanguhañtem
nizbayemi ashôish vanghuyå [cistôish vanghuyå]
nizbayemi razishtayå cistayå nizbayemi hvarenô
airyanãm dah'yunãm nizbayemi hvarenô ýimâi
xshaêtâi hvãthwâi.
segments.zh: '我祈禱阿茲阿赫和薩瓦赫的卡爾什瓦雷；'我祈禱弗拉達哈夫舒和維達哈夫舒的卡爾什瓦雷；'我祈禱沃魯巴雷什提和沃魯紮雷什提的卡爾什瓦雷；'我祈禱明亮的赫瓦尼拉塔；'我祈禱明亮、榮耀的海圖曼特；'我祈禱善良的阿希；〔'我祈禱善良的奇斯塔；〕'我祈禱最純淨的奇斯塔；'我祈禱雅利安地域的榮耀；'我祈禱明亮的伊瑪的榮耀，善良的牧人。

segments.orig:
ýashtô xshnûtô frithô paiti-
zañtô sraoshô ashyô huraodhô verethraja
sraoshô ashyô, âthre zaothrå frabarôish
xrûzhdranãm aêsmanãm âthre frabarôish
vohu-gaonanãm baoidhinãm âthre frabarôish
âtrem vâzishtem frâyazaêsha daêum
janem speñjakhrîm, hvâsta hvarethå frabarôish
perenãm vikhzhârayeiñtîm.
segments.en:
'Let him be worshipped with sacrifice,
let him be gladdened, gratified, and satisfied, the
holy Sraosha, the well-formed, victorious, holy
Sraosha.
'Bring libations unto the Fire, bring hard wood
unto the Fire, bring incense of Vohu-gaona unto
the Fire.
'Offer up the sacrifice to the Vazishta fire, which smites
the fiend Spenjaghra: bring unto it the
cooked meat and full overflowing libations.
segments.zh:
應當以祭祀來崇拜他，令持阿沙的聖者、形貌完美、所向披靡、持阿沙的聖者斯勞沙歡喜、滿足、心悅。
向火獻上奠酒，向火獻上堅硬木柴，向火獻上沃胡‧高納的香氣。
向瓦日什塔火獻上祭祀，此火打擊迭瓦斯彭賈格拉：向它獻上熟肉和豐溢的奠酒。

segments.orig:
sraoshô ashyô frâyazaêsha, sraoshô

daêvayasnanãm merezujîtîm mashyânãm
[nazdishtå dainghâvô ýaozhdâthryât
haca frakaire frakerenaot vâstre verezyôit pasush-hvarethem

segments.en:
'Offer up the sacrifice to the holy
Sraosha, that the holy Sraosha may smite down
the fiend Kunda, who is drunken without drinking,
and throws down into the Hell of the Druj the
wicked Daeva-worshippers, who live in sin.
[42. 'I invoke the Kara fish
, who lives beneath
waters in the bottom of the deep lakes.
'I invoke the ancient and sovereign Merezu, the
most warlike of the creatures of the two Spirits.
'I invoke the seven bright Sru ...']
segments.zh:
向持阿沙的聖者斯勞沙獻上祭祀，願持阿沙的聖者斯勞沙擊倒迭瓦昆達，他醉而未飲，並將為惡的迭瓦崇拜者、身陷罪孽的人投入德魯格的地獄。
〔我祈禱卡拉魚，住在水中深湖的底部。
我祈禱古老而至高的梅雷祖，二靈所生生物中最好戰的。
我祈禱七位光明的斯魯……〕

segments.zh: 他們周圍大呼，他們的心意搖擺不定，致命的安格拉‧曼紐，迭瓦之迭瓦；迭瓦因德拉，迭瓦薩烏魯，迭瓦南格海提亞，陶爾維與紮伊里；殺戮之槍的埃什瑪；迭瓦阿卡塔什；由迭瓦所造的冬季；欺騙的、無形的死亡；祖爾瓦，禍害列祖；迭瓦布伊蒂；迭瓦德里維；迭瓦戴維；迭瓦卡斯維；帕伊蒂什，最迭瓦化的迭瓦。

segments.orig:
daêvô uiti davata hô ýô duzhdå
angrô mainyush pouru-mahrkô, cim hãm-beretha
hãm-bârayama daêva drvañtô duzhdånghô
arezûrahe paiti kameredhem.
segments.en:
'And the evil-doing Daeva, Angra
Mainyu, the deadly, said: "'What! let the wicked,
evil-doing Daevas gather together at the head of
Arezura!"
segments.zh: 邪惡作為的迭瓦、致命的安格拉‧曼紐說：「嗎！願邪惡作為的迭瓦們聚集於阿雷祖拉之首！」

segments.orig:

daêva drvañtô duzhdånghô, imem

segments.en:
'They rush away shouting, the wicked,
evil-doing Daevas; they run away shouting, the
wicked, evil-doing Daevas; they run away casting
the Evil Eye, the wicked, evil-doing Daevas: "Let
us gather together at the head of Arezura!
segments.zh: 他們疾馳呼號，邪惡作為的迭瓦們；他們奔逃呼號，邪惡作為的迭瓦們；他們奔逃投出惡眼，邪惡作為的迭瓦們：「願我們聚集於阿雷祖拉之首！

segments.orig:
zâtô bê ýô ashava zarathushtrô
nmânahe pourushaspahe kva hê aoshô viñdâma
hâu daêvanãm snathô hâu daêvanãm
paityârô hâu druxsh vîdruxsh, nyåñcô
daêvayâzô nasush daêvô-dâtô
draogô mithaoxtô.
segments.en:
'"For he is just born the holy Zarathushtra,
in the house of Pourushaspa. How can we
procure his death? He is the weapon that fells the
fiends: he is a counter-fiend to the fiends; he is
a Druj to the Druj. Vanished are the Daeva-worshippers,
the Nasu made by the Daeva, the
false-speaking Lie!"
segments.zh: 「因為持阿沙的查拉圖斯特拉剛在普魯沙斯帕的家中誕生。我們如何能使他死亡？他是擊倒迭瓦的利器：他是對迭瓦的反迭瓦；他是對德魯格的德魯格。迭瓦崇拜者消失無蹤，由迭瓦所造的納蘇，說謊的謊言！」

segments.orig:
adâuñta advareñta daêva drvañtô
duzhdånghô bûnem anghêush temanghahe ýat
erekhatô daozhanguhahe!
ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
'They rush away shouting, the wicked,
evil-doing Daevas, into the depths of the dark,
raging world of hell.
'Ashem vohu: Holiness is the best of all good.'
segments.zh:
他們疾馳呼號，邪惡作為的迭瓦們，進入黑暗、狂怒的地獄世界的深淵。
阿舍姆‧沃胡：聖潔是所有美善中最至上的。
